reaction: It was useful to see how the mucus and microbial products fit into the same colon.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the microbes with the food remainder was most worthwhile: it showed that some bacteria can ferment fibre our own enzymes leave behind, producing fatty acids and gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the fermenting contents to the body was a little repetitive because the final picture showed many of the same exchanges again.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the colon's cells can use some fatty acids made by microbes from leftover fibre.

arbitrary.text: Adding mucus made sense because it belongs on the lining, though I did not know its relationship to the microbes until the result showed it separating most bacteria from the lining.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter because seeing how microbes and the body exchange materials made me curious about other connections.
